complete_inventory: inventory.json contains every owned provider type and the exact lifecycle remainder; docs/terraform-provider-apis.json is authoritative. The illustrative list below is not the full remaining list.

retained_original_evidence.scope: Original standalone PostgreSQL 17.11 / MySQL 8.4.11, lindm_admin underscore username, 20 to 30 requested GiB, native commit/rollback, wrong password, retained SQL and controller restart. Original evidence is not modified. Expanded fixture coverage is not a claim of an exercised run.

prerequisites.platform: Linux, loopback native SQL, unprivileged controller port (shared runner default 14704)
prerequisites.controller: Existing built bin/stackd; -rds-runtime=true; same owned SQLite installation across restart; local Docker unix:///var/run/docker.sock
prerequisites.mysql_client: Optional Oracle MySQL CLI supporting --no-defaults --protocol=TCP --ssl-mode=DISABLED --get-server-public-key; otherwise pinned image's mysql CLI using --pull=never --network=host. The explicit loopback plaintext adapter uses RSA password exchange for uncached caching_sha2_password authentication, including wrong-password checks; it does not claim trusted remote TLS.
prerequisites.provider_installation: Required runner --provider-mirror prepared filesystem directory; exact source version and generated workspace lock
prerequisites.private_artifacts: Run and RDS/import subdirectories mode 0700; generated password tfvars 0600; state and plans remain under private directory; reports contain no credentials or state contents

native_assertions: Exact PostgreSQL 17.11 and MySQL 8.4.11 native versions; underscore master username
Real CLI commit, rollback, retained rows, wrong password and old-password rejection after Terraform rotation
Immediate PostgreSQL statement_timeout SHOW 7s to 9s; native MySQL session wait_timeout SELECT 7000 to 9000
Terraform tagging and requested AllocatedStorage 20 to 30 GiB control intent
Repeated normal and refresh-only plans have detailed exit code zero
Independent resource import, refresh-only output reconciliation and repeated no-change refresh; secondary state relinquishes all imports without destroying resources
Manual native physical snapshots, private restore ACL read, Terraform snapshot restores retain committed SQL and exclude source writes performed after capture
Real Aurora-compatible cluster/writer owners, Data API named binding, real transactions with commit and rollback, result metadata, and cross-check through native CLI
Shared controller restart verification; Terraform destroy followed by signed API absence and empty primary state

important_limits.capacity: AllocatedStorage is retained requested GiB intent, not physical allocation, reservation, filesystem resizing, quota enforcement, IOPS or throughput
important_limits.aurora: Single local native PostgreSQL/MySQL writer, not managed Aurora replication or distributed storage. Terraform creates cluster controls before their native primary writers. Empty controls have no SQL endpoint and cannot execute Data API statements. A normal refresh-only apply records the completed writer topology before separate strict no-change plans. Omitted or explicit default PromotionTier0 is supported; nonzero tiers and native writer failover remain unsupported.
important_limits.password_import: Passwords cannot be read back from RDS imports. Independent import proof is refresh-only; primary lifecycle state supplies no-change normal plans.
important_limits.snapshots: Manual local physical capture/restore only, private ACL. Cross-account/public sharing remains unsupported; DescribeDBSnapshotAttributes reads actual scoped ownership, including not-found and authorization. Attached writer deletion does not require SkipFinalSnapshot: the cluster owns snapshots. Standalone instance and cluster deletion still require SkipFinalSnapshot=true; final snapshot creation remains unsupported.
important_limits.network_security: No managed VPC/security-group isolation, TLS or IAM database authentication. Native password authentication uses loopback CLI with TLS disabled.
important_limits.managed_flags: Explicit false storage_encrypted/publicly_accessible/auto_minor_version_upgrade and zero backup_retention_period are disabled intent, not managed capabilities. Nonzero automated backup retention, true managed encryption or security-group IDs must not be accepted as implemented features.

not_exercised_settings: Storage encryption, KMS, physical capacity, autoscaling, IOPS/throughput
IAM database authentication, managed master-password rotation
Serverless scaling, performance insights, monitoring and log export
